hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. On each swap, it routes tokens through Euler vaults, computes quotes using a configurable price curve (CurveLib), and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all accounting — bypassing Uniswap v4's internal CLAMM entirely. Liquidity addition and donations are blocked to prevent unproductive positions.
